title: Blank Banshee 0 cover art
lede: A low-polygon 3D head floating in a purple-to-cyan gradient under a wide italic title.
summary: Low-poly game-style head on a purple-to-cyan gradient. 2012.

evidence.note: Inspected the 1200 × 1200 cover on the album’s [Bandcamp page](https://blankbanshee.bandcamp.com/album/blank-banshee-0), in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear on two diagnostics: a smooth purple-to-cyan gradient and an early 3D render. Wikipedia names the album, with Floral Shoppe, as a turning point of the genre.

context: Wikipedia: “In September [2012], Blank Banshee released his debut album, Blank Banshee 0,” which Bandwagon called a “progressive record” that, along with Floral Shoppe, “reconfigured what it means to make vaporwave music.” [Wikipedia: Vaporwave](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaporwave).
observed: The background is a vertical gradient from violet at the top to bright cyan at the bottom, with no texture.
A flat-shaded, low-polygon female head with angular brows and pink lips floats in the centre, cut off at the neck.
BLANK BANSHEE runs across the top in white, heavy, extended italic capitals with an A that has no crossbar.
interpretation: The most economical statement of the style: one dated 3D object and one gradient. The head reads like a late-1990s console character model.
borrow: Use a single two-stop violet-to-cyan gradient behind one untextured 3D object, with no other decoration.

rights.statement: Copyrighted album art. No image is stored here.
